<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Records only narrow: for every type of records and meanings, the candidates of a form after further records are the earlier candidates that stand on those records. Cooperative naming: for every lexicon whose transition record groups the two-word encoding, with the naming source admitted and support for one naming per accessible meaning, after naming every accessible atom, each record offering the accessible alternatives, the candidates of the word of an accessible atom are exactly its earlier candidates that are accessible, and those of every other word are unchanged; a visit’s local naming is this law. The lexicon after selected encounters (acquired 51) is an instance of the separation law: its records separate both atoms, so every finite encoded sequence is interpreted as the assembly of its atoms. Access records acquired through the specified preliminary surveys and current binding ambiguity select subsequent actual encounters, producing the prior interpretation inputs. Reobserving stale access revises the next choice; actual response and failures have separate witnesses.

Canonical source: [EncounterChoice.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/EncounterChoice.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Spatial law, categories, location catalogue, preliminary itinerary and first-match candidate-reduction choice are supplied; cooperative naming concerns actually accessible atomic operations.
- Reuse the existing acquisition/formation/grouping/binding history. The successful witness starts with 51 support units; interpretation computation and memory maintenance have no separate charges.
- Reobservation and rearrangement are supplied interventions; full autonomous calibration, the origin of the choice criterion and physical relocation cost are not derived.

Choice reads retained access, bindings and attempted locations rather than actual scene truth; naming and movement occur in the same arrangement. This explains a local inquiry continuation, without identifying a particular child algorithm or complete reciprocal communication.
